The Bluejays, led by fourth-year head coach [[Greg McDermott]], played their home games at the [[CenturyLink Center Omaha]], and were in their first season as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 27–8, 14–4 in Big East play to finish in second place. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2014 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] where they lost to Providence. They received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated Louisiana–Lafayette in the first round before losing in the second round to Baylor. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header|year=2013|team=Creighton Bluejays|teamcolors=y|high_school=y}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Austin|last=Chatman|num=1|pos=G|ft=6|in=0|lbs=185|class=jr|home=[[The Colony, Texas|The Colony, TX]]|high_school=[[The Colony High School|The Colony]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Steve|last=Ferrarini|link=|num=2|pos=G|ft=6|in=1|lbs=180|class=so|rs=|home=[[Omaha, Nebraska|Omaha, NE]]|high_school=[[Westside High School (Omaha)|Westside]]
